Taking the main body of the product as the absolute benchmark, strictly keeping its shape, size, position and perspective unchanged, intelligently reconstruct the scene space structure to achieve perfect matching. First, lock the product edge outline, surface normal and vanishing point as the core constraints, and force the scene perspective grid to align with the original perspective of the product (including focal length, viewpoint height and FOV). Reconstruct the scene depth level through the three-dimensional bounding box, and reversely optimize the scene shooting parameters to ensure perspective compatibility. Reversely calculate the light source position based on the material characteristics of the product, and dynamically balance the global illumination intensity to achieve physical-level light and shadow interaction. Use sub-pixel masks to accurately cut product edges, generate adaptive contact shadow layers and environmental reflection maps, and superimpose atmospheric perspective effects to enhance spatial consistency. Ultimately, ensure that the product space is anchored stably in dynamic scenes, and the movement of scene elements strictly follows the product perspective rules, achieving a commercial-grade synthesis effect with zero deformation, 100% perspective subordination, physical-level light effects and seamless edge fusion.
